spells.name: Ember Lance
spells.text:
A lance of embers streaks toward a creature within range. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, the target takes 3d8 Fire damage.

**Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot.** The damage increases by 1d8 for each spell slot level above 1.

spells.name: Hearth Ward
spells.text: A willing creature you touch gains a +1 bonus to Armor Class until the spell ends.

spells.name: Whispered Map
spells.material: a map drawn in your own hand
spells.text: You whisper the name of a place you have visited within 1 mile, and the map shows you the shortest safe way there. The way updates as you travel until the spell ends.
